name: Viorelle
summary: Viorelle is defined by graceful balance and quiet strength. Upholstered in rich, textured fabric, the seat and backrest invite comfort while maintaining a refined silhouette. The base, crafted in stainless steel with brushed finishes of nickel or bronze, lends a sculptural elegance that anchors the design. Subtle yet striking, it carries the poise of contemporary European living, bringing sophistication to both modern and classic interiors. 59x59x80
